old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a cooking process on a gas stove. A person is seen using a black spatula to stir a mixture of eggs in a small, round, silver pot placed on one of the burners. The stove has four black burners, and the flame beneath the pot is blue, indicating it is turned on. The person's hands are visible; one holds the handle of the pot while the other wields the spatula, moving it around the pot to ensure even cooking. The background shows part of a white kitchen countertop. The scene is well-lit, suggesting an indoor setting with good lighting. There are no animals or significant changes in the environment throughout the video, focusing solely on the cooking activity.

caption: The video captures a close view of a small metal saucepan with a black handle resting on a lit gas burner, its blue flame flickering beneath the pan on a white stovetop. A person's two hands enter the frame, one gripping the pan's handle at the right while the other holds a black silicone spatula marked with a small red logo. The spatula head works through a partly set yellow egg mixture showing soft curds suspended in liquid. Throughout the excerpt the spatula moves in a continuous stirring and folding motion, shifting between the left, center, and right sides of the pan and displacing the curds. The hand on the spatula makes small positional adjustments, tilting the handle slightly, while the hand on the pan handle remains steady. A pale marble-look countertop fills the background beside an unused burner grate to the left. The egg mixture stays semi-liquid and in motion, the stirring process ongoing.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.

replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
